name: Winter Icelea
description: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.
fullDescription: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.\nAccording to the folklore of the northern lands, these plants are the loyal warriors of the King of Winter Icelea. Though each blossom lasts only from dawn to dusk and is easily swept away by wind or rain, the leaves and roots cling stubbornly to life. As long as those roots endure, new buds will continue to bloom, carrying the plant through the long winter until spring finally returns.
sources: Found at the Pillar of Embla
